title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the photocopied club flyer. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Photocopied club flyer
options.lineage: 90s Chicago and Detroit party flyers, xeroxed on fluoro stock
options.thesis: The mix's tracklist set like a flyer's lineup: who played, how sure we are, what's in your bag.
options.viewport: Pink flyer-stock header with the mix name in heavy condensed type; below, the tracklist as a lineup where confirmed tracks are set large and unconfirmed ones small under 'plus'.
options.risk: Condensed heavy type can crowd a 400 px panel if the scale is not disciplined.

raised.raise: One quantized grey ramp is the only neutral set; no ad hoc greys.
Confidence is carried by one ranked variable, type size, and nothing else.
While carting, the current track and the next one are both visible.
Every row keeps the same geometry in every state, so states compare at a glance.
No card chrome: rows are type on the ground, separated by plain rules.

options.label: White label
options.lineage: hand-stamped white-label 12-inch centre labels and test pressings
options.thesis: Each track you cart gets stamped, like a promo copy marked for the bag.
options.viewport: Off-white panel, the mix name and duration like a label's side A text; each carted row takes a blue stamp with the store and price.
options.risk: Quiet and tasteful, close to where most runs for music tools land.

options.label: Mix as a transit line
options.thesis: The mix runs as one line; each track is a station at its timestamp.
options.viewport: A vertical line down the left with stations at 1:00, 2:00, 8:00; each station's state (carted, searching, not found) reads as its marker.
options.case: Strongest on clarity of progress through the mix; DJs do not see their own world in it.
options.risk: Reads as a transport app if the line is not clearly the mix.

options.label: Darkroom exposure record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets over a zone ramp.
options.case: Neither DJs nor the cart task live here.
options.kept: One quantized grey ramp as the only neutrals.

options.label: Vertical feed
options.thesis: One track fills the panel at a time.
options.viewport: One track per screen, snap to next.
options.case: Hides the list a DJ needs to scan.
options.kept: The next track is always already visible.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Giant cropped type, flat colour tiles.
options.kept: No container chrome; type and rules carry the structure.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.case: No tie to DJs or carts.
options.kept: Identical row geometry across every state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean extension panel like 1Password or Raindrop, done well.
canonCard.viewport: Header with the mix name, a checkbox list of tracks, one primary 'Add to cart' button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other extension by design.
